questions.q_en: Two goods trains 132 m and 108 m in length are running towards each other on parallel tracks. The first train is running at a speed of 32 km/h and the second at a speed of 40 km/h. How much time will they take to cross each other after meeting?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of two trains are 32 km/h and 40 km/h respectively

Length of the two train = 132 m and 108 m respectively

So total length = 132 + 108 =240 m

Relative speed = (32 + 40) km/h (as they are moving in same direction)

= 72*5/18 m/sec =20 m/sec

So time needed to cross each other = 240 /20 =12 sec

Option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Two stations R and S are 400 km apart from each other. A train leaves from R to S and simultaneously another train leaves from S to R. Both trains meet after 10 hours. If the speed of the first train is 4 km/h more than the second train, then what is the speed of the slower train?
questions.solution_en:
Let the speed of slower and faster train is 's' km/h and 's + 4' km/h.

Relative speed of both the trains when travelling towards each other = s + (s + 4) = (2s + 4) km/h

Distance between both the trains = 400 km

(2s + 4) * 10 = 400

2s + 4 = 40

s = 18

Speed of slower train = s = 18 km/h

questions.q_en: Two trains are running on parallel tracks, in the same direction at the speed of 80 km/h and 90 km/h, respectively. The trains crossed each other in 3 minutes. If the length of one train is 230 m, then what is the length (in m) of the other train?
questions.solution_en:
Since trains are running in same direction. So, relative speed = 90 - 80 = 10 km/h = 10 * 5/18 m/s = 25/9 m/s

Time taken by trains to cross each other = (sum of length of both the trains)/(relative speed)

3 * 60 = (230 + length of other train)/(25/9)

230 + length of other train = 500

Length of other train = 270 meters

questions.q_en: A train covers 450 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 5 km/h more, it would have taken 1 hour less to cover the same distance. How much time will it take to cover 315 km at its usual speed?
questions.solution_en:
Let the speed of train = 's' km/h

According to the question:

s2 + 5s = 2250

s2 + 5s - 2250 = 0

After solving:

s = 45

Time taken to cover 315 km at usual speed = 315/s = 315/45 = 7 hours

questions.q_en: The two trains leave Varanasi for Lucknow at 11:00 a.m. and at 11:30 a.m., respectively and travel at a speed of 110 km/h and 140 km/h, respectively. How many kilometers from Varanasi will both trains meet?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of first train = 110 km/hr

Speed of second train = 140 km/hr

Since trains are travelling in same direction, so relative speed = 140 - 110 = 30 km/hr

Distance covered by first train in (1/2) hr = 110 *(1/2) = 55 km

Time = distance/speed

Time after the departure of second train when both trains will be together = (55/30) hr

Required distance = 140 *(55/30) = 770/3 = 256(2/3) km

questions.q_en: Two trains of lengths 150 m and 250 m run on parallel lines. When they run in the same direction, they take 20 seconds to cross each other and, when they run in the opposite direction, they take 5 seconds to cross each other. What is the speed of the two trains?
questions.solution_en:

Length is given as 150 m and 250 m respectively.

When running in same direction:-

(150+250)/20=x-y

20=x-y----(i)

And when running in opposite direction:-

(150+250)/5=x+y

80=x+y---(ii)

On solving eq (i) and (ii) we get:

X=50 m/sec=50*18/5=180 km/h and

y=30 m/sec =30*18/5=108km/h.

option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Two trains with a speed of 80 km/h and 120 km/h, respectively, are 500 km apart and face each other. Find the distance between them 10 minutes before crossing.
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of the trains when travelling towards each other = 80 + 120 = 200 km

Time taken when they meet = 500/200 = 2.5 hours = 150 min

Sum of distances travelled by the trains 10 minutes before meeting = 200 * (140/60) = 466.67 km

So, distance between trains 10 minutes before crossing = 500 - 466.67

= 33.33 km

questions.q_en: A 252 m long train is running at a speed of 125 km/h. What is the time (in seconds) in which it will pass a man who starts running from the engine at the speed of 17 km/h in the same direction as that of the train?
questions.solution_en:
Let the time, in which the train will pass the man, who is running in the same direction, be 't' seconds.

Since, the relative speed = 125 - 17 = 108 km/h

So,

108 * (5/18) = 252/t

t = 8.4 seconds

questions.q_en: Two trains - A and B- having the lengths 195 m and 165 m, respectively, are running in the same direction on parallel lines. If the speed of A and B be 77 km/h and 85 km/h, respectively, what will be the time (in seconds) taken by them to cross each other?
questions.solution_en:
Distance covered by faster train to cross the slower train = Sum of length of both the trains = 195 + 165 = 360 m

Relative speed of faster train with respect to slower train when running in same direction = 85 - 77 = 8 km/h = 20/9 m/s

Time taken by trains to cross each other = 360 ÷ (20/9)

= 360 * (9/20)

= 162 seconds

questions.q_en: X and Y are two stations which are 280 km apart. A train starts at a certain time from X and travels towards Y at 60 km/h. After 2 hours, another train starts from Y and travels towards X at 20 km/h. After how much time from the start of train which left from X, both trains meet?
questions.solution_en:
Distance covered by the train leaving from X in 2 hr = 60 * 2 = 120 km

Remaining distance = 280 - 120 = 160 km

Now, relative speed = 60 + 20 = 80 km/hr

Time in which both trains meet after the train leaving from Y started = 160/80 = 2 hr

Required time = 2 + 2 = 4 hr
questions.solution_hi:

Required time = 2 + 2 = 4 hr

questions.q_en: A 240 m long train overtakes a man walking at 6 km/h in the same direction, in 9 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take to pass a 372 m long tunnel with the same speed?
questions.solution_en:
Let the speed of the train = p m/s

Speed of man = 6 km/h = 6 * 5/18 = 5/3 m/s

According to the question-

(p - 5/3) * 9 = 240

p - 5/3 = 80/3

p = 80/3 + 5/3

p = 85/3 m/s

Total distance = 240 + 372 = 612 m

Time =612/(85/3)=(612*3)/85

Time = 21.6 seconds

questions.q_en: A train x running at 74 km/h crosses another train y running at 52 km/h in the opposite direction in 12 seconds. If the length of y is two-thirds that of x, then what is the length of x (in m)?
questions.solution_en:
Let the lengths of trains x and y are '3a' and '2a' respectively.

Relative speed of trains x and y = 74 + 52 = 126 km/h

According to the question:

3a + 2a = 126 * 12 * 5/18

5a = 420

a = 84

Length of train x = 3a = 252 m

= 1800/30

= 60 s
